title: Keep Fresh Water Available
description: Make sure your pet has access to clean, fresh water. Clean water containers regularly and check them throughout the day.

title: Build a Consistent Routine
description: Try to keep feeding, enrichment and rest at predictable times suited to your pet's needs.

title: Organise Veterinary Records
description: Keep vaccination dates, veterinary visit information and health notes together. Ask a qualified veterinarian about appropriate preventive care.

title: Make Grooming Comfortable
description: Choose grooming practices appropriate for your pet's species, coat and comfort. Ask a veterinarian or qualified groomer about unfamiliar procedures.

title: Provide Suitable Enrichment
description: Offer safe, species-appropriate activities that encourage exploration and learning. Always supervise activities when needed.

title: Use Positive Training
description: For pets suited to training, use gentle, reward-based methods and short sessions. Adapt activities to the animal's needs and abilities.

title: Prepare Before Adopting
description: Consider the long-term cost, space, time and care needs before adopting. Speak with a reputable shelter or rescue organisation.

title: Make Travel Plans Carefully
description: Plan pet transport in advance and use suitable carriers or restraints. Follow species-appropriate transport guidance and ask your veterinarian if you are unsure.

title: Keep the Living Space Suitable
description: Provide a clean, safe environment that meets your pet's species-specific requirements, including suitable temperature, space and shelter.

title: Choose Food for Your Pet's Needs
description: Choose food appropriate for your pet's species and life stage. Consult a veterinarian about dietary needs, portions and any special health requirements.

title: Make Time for Appropriate Activity
description: Offer safe activity suited to your pet's health, age and abilities. Provide rest and stop activities if your pet shows signs of distress.

title: Keep Important Contacts Ready
description: Know how to contact your regular veterinary practice and locate an appropriate emergency veterinary service in advance.
